# Wilderness First Aid {-}

Who:Adult Leaders, Youth 14+

What: Learn how to safely navigate and respond to medical emergencies in a remote environment (> 1 hour from advanced care)

When: This course is typically run every May in Juniata Valley Council

Where: In-Person ONLY

Why: required by many high adventure camps; recommended for remote treks.

Pre-requisite: CPR/AED

[Wilderness First Aid @ Scouting America National Site](https://www.scouting.org/health-and-safety/wilderness-fa/)
